focus_areas: Boundary integrity between rock and sky
Geometric plausibility and structural coherence of the base structures/water
Depth separation between foreground trees and cliff face
Identification of base objects to contextualize talus absence
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the transition zone between the illuminated rock and the dark sky. Does the texture degrade unnaturally? Also, inspect the bottom-right corner: is the object at the water's edge structurally coherent, or does it exhibit signs of melting/fusion common in AI generations? Verify if the vegetation interacts with the rock surface realistically (occlusion vs. floating). Use the open_vocabulary_detector to confirm if the base contains water/boats, explaining the lack of talus.
image_description: A high-angle view of a steep, sunlit cliff face composed of stratified rock layers. The upper portion is illuminated by warm sunlight, revealing vertical erosion channels and rough texture, while the lower section falls into shadow. Green vegetation (trees/bushes) grows on ledges in the lower left foreground. At the bottom right, a body of water and a small structure or boat are visible at the base of the drop-off.
